raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Customers migrated to the new CRM (from 2026-01-15) carry numeric region codes 01-04 instead of region names. raw_region_map gives an unambiguous one-to-one mapping (01 WEST, 02 EAST, 03 NORTH, 04 SOUTH). silver_customers passes the codes through, so gold_region_daily has wrong region buckets.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(upper(m.region_name), upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON trim(c.region) = m.region_code"}}
